verdict.rationale: Dover documents an official MCP server that gives AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications and interview workflows. It can be added as an HTTP MCP server from the terminal, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting, and documented details on authentication and the full tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Set up the Dover MCP server to give AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows in Dover.
You can add Dover as an HTTP MCP server directly from your terminal.
Ask in plain English, and your AI client picks the right tool.
